excerpt: Verified guidelines for engineering and MCA/BCA students across all Indian universities seeking credit-aligned corporate internships.

title: GQT Pan-India Mega Placement & Internship Fair - 2026 Edition
excerpt: Over 80+ tier-1 technology enterprises hiring final-year and pre-final year students nationwide with competitive stipends.
content: Global Quest Technologies is conducting this flagship all-India internship and hiring drive. Registrations are open to eligible college candidates across India.

title: Guidelines for Submitting Mid-Term Internship Progress Report & Project Viva
excerpt: Detailed rubric and evaluation criteria for 8-week, 12-week, and 6-month industrial internship evaluations.
content: Guidelines for online and hybrid project reviews, portfolio code assessments, and viva voce conducted in coordination with university guides.

title: Free Pan-India AI & GenAI Upskilling Bootcamp by GQT Foundation
excerpt: 4-week intensive weekend masterclass covering LLMs, PyTorch, LangChain, and cloud deployment open to students across India.
content: Open enrollment for aspiring engineers to gain hands-on credentials in modern Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and cloud production.

title: Pan-India Remote Internship Verification & Digital Logbook Standards
excerpt: Comprehensive guidelines on remote mentor sign-offs, weekly sprint logs, and digital attendance verification for remote interns.
content: Partner companies offering remote internships provide regular sprint reviews and digital project check-ins to ensure genuine project immersion.

content: Shortlisted engineering candidates will undergo specialized firmware training followed by company placement interviews.

title: National Cyber Security CTF Tournament & Fast-Track Internship Drive
excerpt: Participate in the 36-hour nationwide Capture The Flag (CTF) tournament with direct corporate internship offers.
content: Top teams receive interview opportunities and fast-tracked summer/pre-placement internship letters with stipends up to ₹35,000/month.
